1477-4131-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-4131-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2301-4279-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1436-2872-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-2872-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6723-7296.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

206-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5035-5104-8095.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-8095.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

2738-3967-4871-6255.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-2728-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
413-2728-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-2728-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

533-5430-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-5430-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Jaya, Venerated Firemage.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

413-1580-4871-6887.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

7009-7012-7704.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
7009-7012-7704.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doc Samson.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3490-4455-6798-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4455-6798-7426.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

3532-3949-5078-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-2034-4544--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2034-4544--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-2034-4544--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

252-2099-5394.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

372-1309-3603.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-1309-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1887-3774-4013-4554.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1365-2511-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2511-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

511-767-3008-3048.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Druids' Repository has at least one charge counter on it.
Sporoloth Ancient has at least one spore counter on it.
511-767-3008-3048.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient and two charge counters on Druids' Repository.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.Activate Druids' Repository twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

703-1849-2751-2972.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Strionic Resonator that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Strionic Resonator tokens enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Strionic Resonator copy by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 6.

914-2034-2239-2588.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-2239-2588.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Ardent Elementalist, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Agadeem's Awakening by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, returning Ardent Elementalist and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1171-2104-4428.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Regrowth using Garth's ability.
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
1171-2104-4428.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Garth.
Repeat each turn.

2413-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional nontoken enchantments.
2413-4608.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling itself and all other creatures you control and creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token for each creature exiled.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, it triggers itself, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return Day of the Dragons and the other exiled cards to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Note that this is a mandatory loop that will end the game in a draw unless you have a way to end it or to use it for a game-winning effect.

1719-3573-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
You control at least two artifacts.
1719-3573-4222.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

914-2504-2649.manaNeeded: {1}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
914-2504-2649.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2504-2649.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W/U}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable, putting it on top of Dockside Extortionist.
The Vadrok mutated creature triggers, allowing you to cast Unexplained Disappearance from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Unexplained Disappearance, returning Vadrok and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
If your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo produces infinite Treasure tokens.
